entities.name: Tae Jin
entities.description: A young monk follower of Shu Yun in Tarkir's past, a secret Jeskai shaman and Ghostfire Warrior who joined the Atarka Clan.

entities.name: Shu Yun
entities.description: The monk whom Tae Jin followed.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: Dragonlord of the clan Tae Jin officially belonged to; his dragons persecuted him.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: The dragonlord who confronted the hunting band and let Tae Jin join her clan.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: Atarka leader to whom Tae Jin told his visions.

entities.name: Naiva
entities.description: Granddaughter of Yasova who took a shine to Tae Jin.

entities.name: Baishya
entities.description: Granddaughter of Yasova who took a shine to Tae Jin.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker whom Tae Jin saw in a vision.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Planeswalker dragon whose youth was seen in Tae Jin's visions.

events.summary: Tae Jin, a secret Jeskai shaman, is persecuted by Ojutai's dragons and travels to Atarka territory to tell Yasova Dragonclaw of his visions of Ugin and Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: he was persecuted by Ojutai's dragons

events.summary: Atarka confronts the hunting band; Tae Jin saves them with a vision of Nicol Bolas, and Atarka lets him join her clan.
events.quote: The dragonlord allowed Tae Jin to join the Atarka Clan

relations.note: Tae Jin was a follower of Shu Yun.
relations.quote: a young monk follower of Shu Yun
he was persecuted by Ojutai's dragons

relations.note: She protected him from Ojutai's henchmen.
